name: Yash Gupta
headline: Backend Engineer
tagline: Scalable systems, microservices, and data engineering — storage, media, SaaS, search, and analytics.
summary: I like taking messy production systems — analytics pipelines, metadata services, storage platforms — and making them cheaper, faster, and calmer under load. 7+ years across HPE, Sling, Bloomreach, Kong, and now Apple.
about: Hi, I'm Yash Gupta, a backend engineer in Bengaluru. I grew up curious about how systems hold together — Linux boxes, storage arrays, then the APIs and pipelines that sit on top.

Most of my work has been the unglamorous kind that actually moves the needle: migrating Python 2 estates, cutting cloud spend by more than a million a year, redesigning playback and image services so they take 5× the traffic on the same boxes.
Away from the keyboard I follow equities, tinker with new tools, and keep notes so the next problem is a little less surprising. The field doesn't end, and that's the point.

roles.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Building backend systems as part of Apple's engineering organization in Bengaluru.

roles.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Worked on API gateway and service-mesh problems in a short, high-intensity stint.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Investigated and optimized analytics pipelines and jobs, saving about $1.1M per year.
Part of the analytics team processing on the order of 7 million events at peak.
Led Events Management: pixel-quality analysis dropped from ~1 day to under 10 seconds; designed the Events Management API and real-time ingestion path.
Independently led the Python 3 migration (plus arm64, Ubuntu 22.04, Airflow 1.3 → 2.4) in under 4 months, ~$20k/year savings and a cleaner security story.
Mentored junior engineers while shipping features on daily/hourly pipelines.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: CMS team: schedules, channels, programs, series, and images for internal and external Sling systems.
Spot Awards for two consecutive quarters.

roles.title: Software Engineer II
highlights: Co-led the Player Metadata Service redesign: QVT support, 5× RPS on similar resources, API latency under 200ms (~50% faster playback start).
Led Image Service redesign: real-time resize, compression, gradients, and overlays in under 2 months, also at 5× RPS.
Key contributor moving metadata from TiVo to Gracenote.

roles.title: Systems / Software Engineer II
highlights: Core team for Recovery Manager (RMC): on-prem service architecture moved toward cloud microservices.
POCs for production web-service designs: Go/FastAPI, gRPC, Kafka, OpenStack TaskFlow, APScheduler.
Copy-data management revamp in under 7 days: restart time −80%, new storage-system add ~30s → ~5s.
Led Python 2.7 → 3.6 migration for the whole codebase in under 3.5 months.
Six recognition rewards during the HPE tenure.

roles.title: Systems / Software Engineer
highlights: Storage division: snapshots, backups, restores, volumes, FC/iSCSI — Recovery Manager Central on Cinder.

notes: Merit holder 2014–17 (2nd rank, then 3rd rank consecutively)
